_doc: Read by scripts/check_intake_rates.py. expected_stale: courts whose zero intake is BY DESIGN (abolished court, frozen archive, no new volumes); they are reported EXPECTED and never fail the run. A coverage note is NOT an exemption: ow_gerichte and be_steuerrekurs are noted outages that are re-probed weekly and must keep surfacing until the probe yields rows. lag_days: series whose decision dates trail publication by months; the pro-rating window is shifted by that many days and the court is WAIT (not judged) while the remaining window is under 30 days. NOT exempted on purpose: vd_findinfo (its note calls it a frozen pre-2015 archive, but it received 2,444 rows dated 2025 and 0 dated 2026 — a feed death to look at, not a design). Accepted gaps (2026-09-15): be_weitere is a frozen entscheidsuche mirror shard; it is EXPECTED so the nightly list stays actionable. be_bvd left the list on 2026-11-08: its portal answers the TRI filter and the direct scraper is registered.

ch_vb.reason: ended series: the VPB/JAAC ceased publication on 1 Jan 2018; frozen shard from amtsdruckschriften.bar.admin.ch of the 2,502 VPB/JAAC PDFs (1987-2017) plus ~20,400 Bundesblatt, Amtliches Bulletin and Amtliche Sammlung pages, no new intake by design

mkg.reason: Militaerkassationsgericht archival corpus, volumes 1-16 (1915-2025); the court publishes no new volumes

zh_kassationsgericht.reason: court abolished with the federal ZPO; last decisions 2012

emark.reason: EMARK series ended when the Asylrekurskommission was replaced by the BVGer in 2007

zh_gerichte.reason: umbrella code holding only the frozen March-2026 entscheidsuche mirror rows; the direct zh_gerichte scraper files rows under the sub-court codes

ag_gerichte.reason: umbrella code holding only the frozen entscheidsuche mirror rows; the direct ag_gerichte scraper files rows under the sub-court codes

sh_obergericht.reason: redundant entscheidsuche feed; the direct sh_gerichte scraper is at parity (retirement per the 2026-04-29 procedure pending)

tg_obergericht.reason: redundant entscheidsuche feed; the direct tg_gerichte scraper is at parity (retirement pending)

sg_publikationen.reason: umbrella code holding only the frozen entscheidsuche mirror rows; the direct sg_publikationen scraper files rows under the sub-court codes (sg_kantonsgericht, sg_verwaltungsgericht, sg_versicherungsgericht, sg_verwaltungsrekurskommission, sg_handelsgericht, sg_kreisgericht): 233 rows dated 2026 on 2026-09-15

sg_gerichte.reason: frozen entscheidsuche mirror shard (SG Gerichte 1969 to 2026-01, 3,141 rows); the canton's live publications are scraped from publikationen.sg.ch under the sg_* sub-court codes

be_weitere.reason: frozen entscheidsuche mirror shard (BE weitere Behoerden 2002 to 2025-12, 840 rows). Its live sources are scraped directly under be_direktionen since 2026-11-08 (GSI/GEF, BKD, DIJ Grundbuch and Notariat); the shard keeps rulings those pages no longer list (JGK Notariat 2003-2014, old gef.be.ch copies)

ag_baugesetzgebung.reason: BVU Rechtsabteilung collection on ag.ch, read directly since 2026-11-08 (scrapers/cantonal/ag_entscheidsammlungen.py: 249 rulings 1991 to 2021-08-20; the entscheidsuche mirror held 198). ag.ch (checked 2026-09-15): since January 2022 these decisions are published in the AGVE portal and the collection page is no longer continued. The direct ag_gerichte scraper files them under ag_departement_bvu (2022: 14, 2023: 20, 2024: 20, 2025: 16)

zg_datenschutzstelle.reason: section of the Zug GVP yearbook chronology read by zg_gvp: 101 Datenschutzstelle entries, newest dated 2016-12-31 (checked 2026-09-15); the office has contributed no GVP entries since, while the chronology keeps adding Regierungsrat and Anwaltsaufsicht entries to 2026

bge.evidence: 2026-09-09: volume 152 (2026) holds 104 decisions in the corpus, only 28 of them DATED 2026; the official collection publishes 6-12 months after the judgment, so the decision-year count is not judgeable before Q4. bge stays covered by the our_count stall detector in check_scraper_freshness.py.

finma.evidence: 2026-09-15: FINMA publishes the Kasuistik in one annual batch. All 50 cases dated 2025 entered the shard in 2026-04; the search API answers 455 items = ours, none titled 2026. The window never opens inside the decision year; check each May that the previous year's batch arrived.

tg_gerichte.evidence: 2026-09-15: RBOG and TVR are yearbooks. og/rbog-2026 answers 404, rbog-2025 lists 48 entries and we hold 68 rows dated 2025; the decision year is not judgeable before the next yearbook appears.

weko.evidence: 2026-09-15: the portal's newest decision is dated 2025-10-21 and we hold it (scraped 2026-09-08); WEKO publishes after the RPW review, 6 to 12 months after the decision.

lu_gerichte.evidence: 2026-09-15: the LGVE index's newest EnId 11116 is dated 2025-12-23 and equals our max; ids 11117 to 12000 are empty. The LGVE selection appears about a year after the decision, so the decision year is never judgeable inside the year.
